skill: grasp_place

- id: release_1

  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance

skill: grasp_place
dsl_version: 2
skill_type: arm_gripper
subtasks:
- id: approach_target
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.15
  weight: 0.3

  anchor: object
  target_entity: object
  offset:

  - 0.0
  - 0.1
  weight: 0.3
- id: placement
  target_entity: object
  weight: 0.4
phases:
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.15
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: add
  subtask_id: approach_target
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: contact_detected
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.02
  subtask_id: approach_target
- id: grasp_1
  type: grasp
  control: position_control
  termination: time_limit
  end_effector_action: force_grasp
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.02
  parameters:
    grip_force:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 5.0
      - 30.0
      default: 15.0
      binds_to:
      - path: guards.grasp_check.threshold
        mode: replace
  guards:

  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.15
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    lift_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: add
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: lift_clearance
- id: transport_1
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    transport_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: placement
- id: release_1
  type: release
  control: position_control
  termination: time_limit
  end_effector_action: open
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: placement
